summary: feat(core/tool): configure tool descriptions per deployment — `tools.descriptions` replaces the text a tool shows the model, whole or per input-schema parameter, because a description is prompt surface rather than contract and the answer differs per deployment; replacement rather than composition, since the common motive is deleting a sentence that is wrong here and a template cannot delete, with the assembled text available from `Manager.ToolDefinitions` as a starting point. test(core/inference): add the extension conformance suite every driver runs — `inferencetest.RunExtensions` checks what an `inference.Extension` owes the runtime (an addressable identity, an `ActiveFields` that reports exactly the options it sets, a `Validate` that accepts its own sample) and walks a `Clone` with reflection to prove it owns its storage, because a shared pointer, slice or map lets one request's tuning reach another's and surfaces much later as an answer nobody can explain; the three drivers keep their own copies until this package is released, since the driver module builds against its pinned core under `GOWORK=off`. test(core/agent-a2a): give the cancel path a peer that answers it — the cancelled-task test cancelled a task the peer had already paused, which the protocol refuses, so it passed only when its cancel outran the peer's status update and lost that race on a loaded runner; it is now two promises with two peers, and the package runs five times under `-race` in the time the old shape used to hang.
